name: Parts of the Elephant
source:
Weird things are happening in the Elephant Hotel. It's getting late, you're getting drunk, and moments in the lives of strangers are scattered around you like spilled puzzle pieces. Can you put it all together?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930550/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大象旅馆里​​发生了奇怪的事情。天色已晚，你喝醉了，陌生人生活中的时刻像散落的拼图一样散落在你周围。你能把它们放在一起吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930550/]Steam[/url]]
